To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

CEOs of major US corporations believe that strategy research is relevant to their work, but that they have little knowledge of academic journals and that their views on the future of the field differ significantly from those of academics.
CEOs are more interested in operational issues than strategic issues, they are not aware of research-based academic journals, and they do not think that academic journals are relevant to their work.

1) CEOs are generally unfamiliar with the academic literature; 2) CEOs and academics differ in their views of the relevance of the field to practitioners and the future direction of the field; 3) the CEOs agenda is more focused on operating issues than the academics agenda; and 4) the two agendas are complementary.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the issue of the relevance of strategy research.
the relevance of strategic management research to the practice of management.
the relevance of strategic management research.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the field of strategic research has made a major contribution to the practice of management and is likely to continue to make a significant contribution.

the future of strategic management as an academic field depends on the ability of its members to communicate with managers in a language that they understand, and to convince them that strategic management is relevant to their needs.
strategy research is relevant to practitioners, and that it should be more relevant to them.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the field has been successful at developing a body of theory that is relevant to practitioners, and that this success has been achieved by a combination of research that is both rigorous and applied.
the field of strategic research has made great strides in the past 15 years.
the field of strategy has come a long way since the early days of the 1960s.

the field of strategy research is in a state of transition.
strategy researchers need to do more to understand the needs of the business community and to develop a more effective way of communicating their research findings.
the field of strategic analysis needs to be more responsive to managers and their concerns.
